d:
Step into the extraordinary world of the Galápagos Islands with Metropolitan Touring, where remarkable wildlife, crystal-clear waters and untouched landscapes come together in one of the most unique places on Earth
From sea lions swimming beneath the surface and sea turtles gliding through the ocean to incredible wildlife encounters and dramatic volcanic landscapes, discover the natural beauty of this unforgettable Ecuadorian archipelago.
A destination unlike anywhere else, the Galápagos Islands offer a rare glimpse into the wonders of the natural world, both above and below the water.
